notes.title: Passive Stats Readjustment (Major Optimization Fix + Update)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Long time ago I had an issue where players near the end of the game approached a strange stuttering issue on the world map. I found out that it was tied to a RPG Maker MV plugin related to passive states as that was how I did the passive stats (such as the 10% HP).

As a result I removed the Auras and one set of passive stats but compensated by improving the previous ones. The reduction of the number of passive stat states 7x12 (84!) greatly improved performance and that stuttering issue should no longer be visible or just barely with a lower end PC. Please let me know if this helped as it can help me develop Radiant Arc 2 (Already 35% done!)

Hopefully this should be save compatible as I only removed skills and changed numbers, not added any.

As well, most end game bosses I have removed their damage reduction by about 20% so it is a bit easier to take them down with the loss of passive auras.

Overall takeaways from this patch:
Two 10% stat buffs -> One 25% stat buff (available at lvl 15)
Removal of Character Auras for team
Overall buffed personal passives usually by about 10% or more. Slightly underperforming characters got more.
Slight decrease in damage reduction for end game bosses.

Thank you everyone for the support over the years and progress on Radiant Arc 2: The After Years is under great progress. I hope you will await the sequel when it is finished and continue the journey with the next generation.

-Linky317, Danny

notes.title: Patch 1.05B
notes.content:
Hi everyone once again, another small patch mainly just little things I noticed or fixed while watching others play.

-numerous amount of bug fixes/mapping errors/etc

-Adjusted Nuria reflex shot from 12 SP to 25SP.
(This skill was way too powerful with SP generating items/abilities)
(As well this skill has a very rare bug where it skips a party members casting skill if reflex shot is used just before a party member's skill is about to finish casting, if it is reported often/happens more often, I will probably remove the skill)

-Tool tips for Aria summon tier AOE spells were kinda messed up, this time should be fixed

Thanks everyone and I hope you are enjoying Radiant Arc. Be sure to drop a review if you liked the game :^3
Progress is going slowly but well for the sequel, updating/polishing the battle system.

-Linky317 (Danny)

notes.title: Patch 1.05A
notes.content:
Hi everyone once again, another small patch.

-Increased Linky's Radiant Strike from 1 Turn CD to 4 Turn CD
(This skill was way to powerful if you could generate SP very quickly)

-Fixed bug with Lumi's Blizz being able to use out of battle.
(This you could exploit by generating free SP out of battle)

-Swinger extra attacks decreased by 1 (five to four)
(While many didn't use this weapon, it has a lot of strong potential in generating SP, leading into the Linky Radiant Strike problem. Will still generate 60 SP with the four AA)

-Updated tool tips for Aria summon tier AOE spells
(clarified to state that it hits multi times)


Thanks everyone and I hope you are enjoying Radiant Arc. Slowly working on a sequel. ːsteamhappyː

-Linky317 (Danny)

notes.title: Patch 1.04A - EDIT
notes.content:
Hey everyone, hope you are all enjoying Radiant Arc.

Did a micro fix on entering the Guild of Light with Linky for the first time. If you had AP upon entering the cutscene, it would be reset to 0 without any warning due to a class change. Since I can't really change it so it remembers how many AP you had before, I gave a warning to spend AP before entering and upon class change, the player will obtain an extra 5 AP for Linky.

If anyone has had their AP stolen away due to the no warning/bug at the Guild of Light, please let me know how much you had lost and I can manually give to you if you give me your save via DM or Discord. 


-readjusted Dark Prince Shield upgraded form (better base stats, same barrier amount)

-fixed numerous typos/bugs

Edit: Micro patch, fixed Chrono's Katana, ability now properly works.


Thank you!

notes.title: Updates and News!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Just a few updates and news before release.

- I've adjusted the release date to be a bit earlier, Radiant Arc will be coming out on May 31st hopefully without delay!

- I've finally figure out how to do put in steam achievements (took way too long XD) and will be implementing them throughout the game, most being achievable through a full playthrough

-Various Balance Changes (upon full release, I will make more detailed bugfix/patch notes)
(since my game involves a lot of characters/skills/builds, balancing can be a bit tricky)

-Bug Fixes/Crashes

-Upon full release, do not hesitate to report bugs through either contacting me through discord or posting on Steam. https://discord.gg/utxN2hU

-I am actually slowly working on a sequel to Radiant Arc, which takes place 20 years in the future! :)

Thank You all, and I hope you will enjoy Radiant Arc.

-Linky317
